005package org.wpilib.hardware.discrete;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.DIOJNI;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice;
009import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
010import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
011import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
012
013/**
014 * Class to read a digital input. This class will read digital inputs and return the current value
015 * on the channel. Other devices such as encoders, gear tooth sensors, etc. that are implemented
016 * elsewhere will automatically allocate digital inputs and outputs as required. This class is only
017 * for devices like switches etc. that aren't implemented anywhere else.
018 */
019public class DigitalInput implements AutoCloseable, TelemetryLoggable {
020  private final int m_channel;
021  private int m_handle;
022
023  /**
024   * Create an instance of a Digital Input class. Creates a digital input given a channel.
025   *
026   * @param channel the SmartIO channel for the digital input
027   */
028  public DigitalInput(int channel) {
029    m_channel = channel;
030
031    m_handle = DIOJNI.initializeDIOPort(channel, true);
032
033    UsageReporting.reportUsage("IO", channel, "DigitalInput");
034  }
035
036  @Override
037  public void close() {
038    DIOJNI.freeDIOPort(m_handle);
039    m_handle = 0;
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Get the value from a digital input channel. Retrieve the value of a single digital input
044   * channel from the FPGA.
045   *
046   * @return the status of the digital input
047   */
048  public boolean get() {
049    return DIOJNI.getDIO(m_handle);
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Get the channel of the digital input.
054   *
055   * @return The GPIO channel number that this object represents.
056   */
057  public int getChannel() {
058    return m_channel;
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Indicates this input is used by a simulated device.
063   *
064   * @param device simulated device handle
065   */
066  public void setSimDevice(SimDevice device) {
067    DIOJNI.setDIOSimDevice(m_handle, device.getNativeHandle());
068  }
069
070  @Override
071  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
072    table.log("Value", get());
073  }
074
075  @Override
076  public String getTelemetryType() {
077    return "Digital Input";
078  }
079}
